episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the impact of global events on mortgage rates and the opportunities they present for buyers. He highlights specialty loan programs for doctors, veterans, and self-employed individuals, providing actionable insights for real estate agents to better serve their clients. The episode also covers current market trends and strategies for navigating high interest rates.
